claude-fable: Claude Fable is Anthropic's newest and most capable model tier, positioned above Claude Opus.
chroma-v.46-flash: Chroma v46 Flash is a fast distilled checkpoint of Chroma by lodestones, an open-source (Apache 2.0) 8.9B community model derived from FLUX.1-schnell. It runs in about 10 steps and is the most output-stable Chroma checkpoint, but it is a small community model, uncensored and well below frontier quality; text-to-image only on LLM7.
dark-beast-krea2: Dark Beast Krea 2 is an uncensored community fine-tune of Krea 2 (Krea's 12.9B open diffusion transformer from June 2026, built for aesthetics and style control), served on the Sogni decentralized GPU network in 10-20 steps. Tuned for photoreal, surreal, fashion, horror and cinematic imagery; weaker at text rendering and precise prompt following than frontier models; text-to-image only on LLM7.
firefly-gpt-image-2: Firefly GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's GPT Image 2 (April 2026, a reasoning-native image model with top-tier text rendering, layout and editing) served through Adobe Firefly, so quality matches GPT Image 2 with Firefly's content policy on top.
firefly-image-5: Adobe Firefly Image 5 (late 2025) is Adobe's own commercially safe image model trained on licensed content, with native 4-megapixel output, strong photoreal portraits and prompt-based layered editing; behind OpenAI and Google frontier models on complex prompts and text.
flux-klein-2: FLUX.2 [klein] (January 2026) is Black Forest Labs' compact 4B/9B open-weight FLUX.2 family member focused on sub-second generation; it unifies text-to-image, editing and multi-reference input in one checkpoint, trading some quality for speed versus full FLUX.2 models.
flux-kontext-max: FLUX.1 Kontext [max] (mid 2025) is Black Forest Labs' premium in-context image editing and generation model, strong at instruction-based edits and character consistency, with good typography for its generation; now one generation behind FLUX.2.
gemini-3.0-pro-image: Gemini 3 Pro Image, known as Nano Banana Pro (November 2025), is Google's flagship image model built on Gemini 3 Pro reasoning, with 4K output, excellent text rendering, infographics and world knowledge via Search grounding; slower and pricier than the Flash image models.
gemini-3.1-flash-image: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, known as Nano Banana 2 (early 2026), is Google's fast image model that delivers close to Nano Banana Pro quality at Flash speed, with Image Search grounding and strong prompt adherence.
gemini-nano-banana-2.1: Nano Banana 2.1 (October 2026) is Google's update to Nano Banana 2 based on Gemini 3.6 Flash: same speed tier, 512px to 4K output, cleaner compositions, in-image text translation, and better prompt following, text and consistency, closing part of the gap to Nano Banana Pro at half the previous API price.
gpt-image-2.5: GPT Image 2.5 is OpenAI's successor to GPT Image 2 (the reasoning-native model that led Image Arena by a record margin in April 2026), offered in Flare and Sunburst tiers for generation and editing, with further gains in text rendering, editing and multi-image consistency.
gpt-image-2.6: GPT Image 2.6 (November 4, 2026) is OpenAI's newest image model, released at the same prices as GPT Image 2.5, adding animated GIF output, image markup, SVG export and a complexity setting; its Flare tier generates about twice as fast as GPT Image 2.5.
gpt-image-2: GPT Image 2 (April 2026, ChatGPT Images 2.0) is OpenAI's first image model that reasons before rendering; it set the largest lead in Image Arena history at launch, with near-perfect multilingual text rendering, layout control and editing.
imagine-1.5: ImagineArt 1.5 (2026) is ImagineArt's own text-to-image model focused on photographic realism, prompt accuracy and reliable typography on signs, packaging and screens; a smaller independent vendor ranked below OpenAI and Google flagships.
